notes:
- The empty-state orb breathes instead of tearing: The orb now morphs between the nine-sided cookie and the soft burst, the adjacent pair from Material's loading-indicator sequence. The old endpoint was an eight-petal flower, whose curves have no stable correspondence with the cookie's, so the middle of the animation folded through itself. The icon and silhouette also share one clock now.
- One icon for an empty list: Profile > Activity showed a comment bubble and Profile > Library a timer for the same empty list, with a magnifier once a search matched nothing. An ordinary empty list uses the list glyph on both now; the magnifier is reserved for a search or filter that actually narrowed the list, and a filtered Library now says "No titles match these filters".
- A calmer, more expressive orb: The morph rests on each silhouette, breathes through the change with the icon, and draws a soft aura behind the shape. Container and glyph colours cross-fade instead of snapping, and the loop is one named motion token.
- The tier board expands instead of cutting: Opening a list, leaving it and switching profile tabs share one motion language - a short travel, a bouncy scale-in, and a page underneath that recedes instead of sliding away. The shelf-to-board switch used to be a hard cut and now animates, keyed on the list's id so edits do not replay it. The unranked tray grows up from the bottom edge, the floating buttons ride it, and a carried poster springs up as it is picked up.
- Tier exports are sharper, and complete: PNG posters are filled into their rounded tiles with a bitmap shader instead of clip-and-blit, because path clipping is not anti-aliased and every 4K cover had a stair-stepped corner inside a smooth outline. The SVG export wrote translucent colours as Android's #AARRGGBB, which SVG reads as #RRGGBBAA, so white subtitles and captions came out mint; it uses fill-opacity and stroke-opacity now, draws the per-tier counts and the poster hairline, and clips a long title or tier name to the page. Shared images are pruned from the cache.
- Smaller tier-list fixes: An empty board whose library is still loading no longer says "No titles left to place" when its tap adds titles, and a dragged poster's lift is a real animation now - it was an animation whose target never changed, so the ghost was born already grown.
- Ani-chan has ninety-two more things to say: The joke pool grew from 475 lines to 567, with every tone gaining. The new material is about the app itself - exporting a board, the widget counting, the heatmap's missing day, this changelog - and about individual shows: the cut that lands on the drum, the ending theme whose first frame is the finale's last shot, the sequel that lives in a press release. Three lines that claimed a placement or a screen the reader might not be on were rewritten, and two more were the weakest in their tone: a joke about the app is only funny while it is true.
- A preview is no longer cut short: Each trigger now owns the line it showed. Every effect used to end its turn by hiding whatever pill was up, so a preview tapped two seconds into a timed joke was dismissed when the old joke's time ran out, and a preview could hide a newer timed line the same way. A moment line cancelled by leaving the page had it worse - its hide came after the waiting dwell, which cancellation skips, so the pill stayed up with nothing left to remove it. A show now carries a token, and only the current one can hide it.
- Readable pills, readable choices: Ani-chan's name and the "Tap to dismiss" caption measured about 4.0:1 and 3.3:1 against the pill in the default dark theme, under the 4.5:1 small text needs, and the unsaved heart was under the 3:1 a control needs. All three are raised. On the Jokes page the Mixed quick-pick, which is selected but cannot be tapped, was drawn in the disabled grey; a selected-and-locked chip now reads as selected, and only a genuinely disabled one is dimmed.
